name: FLE Studio quick knowledge probe
source: Written for FLE Studio, 24 plain facts in English and German; dedicated to the public domain (CC0 1.0).
note: Easy on purpose: a healthy model answers nearly all of them, a damaged quantization does not. For a harder test import MKQA questions (see docs/QUALITY.md).
